text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 107,507.25 in Period 6 to 100,553.90 in Period 9, reminding me that gains can reverse; I should keep risk aligned with my need for stability in retirement.","I made no trades during the decline, so I should review whether my holdings remain appropriately diversified and rebalance when needed rather than assume holding is always best.","Selling some A and D after gains reduced exposure, but I should base future trades on my overall plan and current risks—not recent price moves or the urge to trade often."]}
